lessons.title: One Pour

play.shortDesc: Two colours, three bottles, one pour
play.targetObjective: Pour so every bottle holds one colour.
stepByStep: Tap the bottle you want to pour from.
Tap the bottle to pour into.
A colour only goes onto the same colour, or into an empty bottle.
play.kidTip: Look for the two bottles that share a colour.
play.audioPrompt: Pour the colours together. One pour finishes this rack.

lessons.pedagogyTip: One move isolates the rule before any planning is asked for.

lessons.title: Two Pours

play.targetObjective: Pour so every bottle holds one colour.
stepByStep: Find a colour sitting on top of another.
Pour it onto its match.
Do the same again.
play.kidTip: Only the top colour ever moves.
play.audioPrompt: Two pours this time. Move each colour onto its match.

lessons.pedagogyTip: A second repetition before anything new is introduced.

lessons.title: Use the Empty Bottle

play.shortDesc: The spare bottle is the only way through
play.targetObjective: Use the empty bottle to unstack the colours.
stepByStep: Find a colour with nowhere to go.
Pour it into the empty bottle.
Now the colour underneath can move.
play.kidTip: An empty bottle takes any colour.
play.audioPrompt: There is one empty bottle. It will take any colour you need to move.

lessons.pedagogyTip: The empty bottle is the first tool, and the first thing worth spending carefully.

lessons.title: The Whole Run Moves

play.targetObjective: Move a run of the same colour in a single pour.
stepByStep: Find two or three of the same colour stacked together.
Pour them onto their match.
They all move at once, if there is room.
play.kidTip: Three the same is still one pour.
play.audioPrompt: Colours that are stacked together move as one. Watch how many travel.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Naming the whole-run rule stops a child counting pours one segment at a time.

lessons.title: Sort Three Colours

play.shortDesc: The first rack that needs a plan
play.targetObjective: Sort all three colours into their own bottles.
stepByStep: Look at the whole rack before pouring.
Decide which bottle you can empty first.
Pour, then look again.
play.kidTip: Think about which bottle you want to empty, not just which pour is possible.
play.audioPrompt: Three colours now. Look at the whole rack before you pour.

lessons.pedagogyTip: The first rack where a legal pour is not automatically a good one.

lessons.title: Short and Tall

play.shortDesc: Bottles that hold three, four or five
play.targetObjective: Sort the rack when the bottles are different sizes.
stepByStep: Look at how tall each bottle is.
A short bottle fills sooner than a tall one.
Check there is room before you pour.
play.kidTip: A taller bottle holds more. Count the space, not the bottles.
play.audioPrompt: These bottles are different sizes. Check how much room there is before you pour.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Capacity becomes a thing to read rather than assume once it stops being uniform.

lessons.title: Will It Fit?

play.shortDesc: The colours match, but the room does not
play.targetObjective: Find the pours that actually fit.
stepByStep: Find a colour sitting on its match.
Count the empty space in the bottle below it.
If it will not all fit, look for another pour.
play.kidTip: Matching colours is not enough. There has to be room.
play.audioPrompt: Sometimes the colours match but there is not enough room. Count the space first.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Separating 'legal colour' from 'enough room' is the first two-part condition in the skill.

lessons.title: Fill It to the Top

play.shortDesc: A bottle is only finished when it is full
play.targetObjective: Fill each bottle exactly to the top with one colour.
stepByStep: Pick a colour to collect.
Bring every part of it into one bottle.
The bottle is done when it is full and one colour.
play.kidTip: Half a bottle of one colour is not finished yet.
play.audioPrompt: A bottle is finished when it is full and holds one colour. Fill each one to the top.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Naming the finish condition stops a child stopping at a tidy-looking half-bottle.

lessons.title: Count Before You Pour

play.shortDesc: See how many will travel before you commit
play.targetObjective: Know how many segments a pour will move.
stepByStep: Tap a bottle to pick it up.
The number shows how many will pour.
Check they will all fit before you tap the next bottle.
play.kidTip: The number on the bottle is how many are about to move.
play.audioPrompt: When you pick a bottle up, the number tells you how many will pour.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Turning the run length from something noticed into something read makes the whole-run rule usable.

lessons.title: Practice: Pouring

play.shortDesc: Five racks across everything so far
stepByStep: Look at the whole rack first.
Decide which bottle to empty.
Pour, then look again.
play.kidTip: No hints here. Take your time.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Practice measures pace across the taught techniques, so it draws from all of them rather than one.
